faq.q: What exactly does the time horizon measure?

faq.a: It has been doubling approximately every 7 months for the last 6 years.
faq.q: How quickly is this metric improving?

faq.a: Extrapolating the trend predicts that in under a decade, AI agents will be able to independently complete a large fraction of software tasks that currently take humans days or weeks, and if the trend continues for 2 to 4 more years, they will be capable of week-long tasks.
faq.q: What does the trend predict for future AI capabilities?

how: Tasks are drawn from a diverse set of multi-step software and reasoning tasks, and the time needed for humans with appropriate expertise is recorded. For each model, a logistic curve is fitted to predict success probability from human task length. The time horizon is then found by locating the task length where the fitted curve intersects a chosen success probability, such as 50%.

results.metric: 50% time horizon: the length of task, in human expert time, the model completes with 50% reliability

measures: The benchmark measures the length of software and reasoning tasks, measured by how long they take human professionals, that a generalist frontier AI agent can complete autonomously with 50% reliability. It records human expert time on diverse multi-step tasks and uses that time to predict model success probability. The resulting time horizon characterizes how long a task a model can handle at a given success rate.
not_measured: It does not measure real-world usefulness or external validity, and the page notes that future changes in trend and external validity concerns are responsible for the majority of uncertainty. It also does not directly measure single-step skills or knowledge, since models often struggle with longer action sequences rather than individual steps.
interpretation: A published result is a time duration, for example Claude 3.7 Sonnet has a time horizon of approximately one hour at 50% success. Readers should interpret it as the length of tasks, in human time, that the model can complete autonomously with that reliability, and note that the trend has been doubling every 7 months.
